A true staple of the modern wardrobe, the single-breasted jacket forms the foundation of a considered collection. Our house cut, with clean lines and a 3-roll-2 button stance, creates a sharp, versatile silhouette, featuring a natural shoulder and subtle waist shaping for effortless, everyday ease.
Fully canvassed with a hand-shaped chest, the jacket drapes naturally over the body, while the hand-attached collar and sleeves offer flexibility unmatched by machine construction, allowing it to move seamlessly with the wearer. The Barchetta breast pocket, named for its “little boat” shape, adds a distinctive finishing touch.
